description: pixel art, top-down view straight from above of a peat bog floor: spongy tussocks of green and rust-red sphagnum moss, dark peat between them, a few tiny pools of dark water, muted dark palette of moss green, rust red and peat brown, a faint pale strip of trampled ground across the middle dividing two halves, slightly darker edges, soft even dusk light, flat ground seen from above for a dim background behind game cards, very low contrast, no standing trees, no people, no animals, no weapons, no text, no border
